cues: Picture it as a floor and a ceiling.
A floor of protection is the minimum everyone must be lifted to: food, basic health care, schooling.
A ceiling on inequality is a limit on how far the top can pull away.
A society can have a floor with no ceiling: everyone eats, but a few own almost everything.
Moyn's point is that human rights give you the floor, and never mention the ceiling.
